scope: Operational observations for one isolated enterprise lab, not a security detector or production deployment.

configuration.SB_METRICS_ENABLED: Default disabled; exactly 1 opts in after operator configuration.
configuration.SB_METRICS_TOKEN: Separate random runtime-only URL-safe token of 32 to 128 characters. Browser sessions and the two case service credentials cannot authenticate this endpoint.
configuration.SB_METRICS_APPS: One to eight explicit provisioned application slugs, no duplicates. Stable order maps to app1 through app8; never reorder an active time series without declaring a new scrape instance.
configuration.SB_MONITORED_WORKERS: One or two distinct worker identities, default default. Order maps to primary and secondary. Configure the same names passed to the worker command.
configuration.transport: HTTPS required. Explicit private CA and dedicated credential file in the reviewed native scrape profile; no host trust-store changes or disabled TLS verification.

interpretation: Application gauges combine all retained source classes and lab/test environments. Fixture replay can update last received; no app-source heartbeat or production-traffic proof is claimed.
Counts are retained database gauges. Retention, backup restoration and reclassification can reduce them; do not use rate() as if they were monotonic counters.
Last seen timestamps and four fixed worker states describe shared worker pulses, not per-app delivery or completed detection.

Sample p95 uses nearest rank over at most 1000 latest valid completions in one hour and includes interruption/retry delay. It is absent when no valid samples exist. It cannot certify the declared 24-hour SLA or excluded-recovery-window targets.
Local SOC staged/file-appended gauges are deliberately separate from native Wazuh observation, reconciliation, heartbeat and connector errors, which remain unfinished.
Filesystem free bytes apply only to the configured workspace volume. They do not attribute Docker/VM growth and do not replace the independent runtime watchdog.
A failed scrape returns an error with no partial metrics. Admission remains recorded after failure; PostgreSQL-only timeout/concurrent admission behavior still needs native verification.
next_native_review: Select official immutable Prometheus/Grafana image identities and inspect the existing cache. No download or launch is authorized by this file.
Prepare exact internal-network services, temporary scoped credentials/CA, loopback-only UI if needed, volume caps/retention, resource budgets and independent shutdown for review.
Validate the scrape and alert files with native promtool; verify real TLS authentication, matched dashboard query results, interruption alerts and verified shutdown.
Keep Alertmanager, external notifications, remote writes, host Docker socket, public deployment and autonomous response disabled.
